g.text: sshpass -p NVCMDemo1! ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o PreferredAuthentications=password -p
Start the SOCKS tunnel, then open the browser with the proxy after deploy is ready.
sshpass -p NVCMDemo1! ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o PreferredAuthentications=password -D 8080
